paragraphs.source_en: That day, Hideyoshi dressed formally at first light and entered the Imperial Palace, where he presented Emperor Go-Yōzei with a memorial announcing his departure for war. After withdrawing, he immediately made ready and, at the head of thirty thousand troops under his command, set out from the Jurakudai at the hour of the serpent.

units.source_en: That day, Hideyoshi dressed formally at first light and entered the Imperial Palace, where he presented Emperor Go-Yōzei with a memorial announcing his departure for war. After withdrawing, he immediately made ready and, at the head of thirty thousand troops under his command, set out from the Jurakudai at the hour of the serpent.
units.source_zh: 这一日，秀吉一早就穿戴整齐进了皇宫，向后阳成天皇奏出征表，之后退出，马上整装，率领旗下三万大军，巳时自聚乐第出发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这一日，秀吉一早就穿戴整齐进了皇宫，向后阳成天皇奏出征表，之后退出，马上整装，率领旗下三万大军，巳时自聚乐第出发。

paragraphs.source_en: That day, the court held a farewell for the warriors departing on the distant campaign. A temporary pavilion was erected between the Four-Legged Gate and the Chinese Gate, where both the Emperor and the Retired Emperor awaited them.

units.source_en: That day, the court held a farewell for the warriors departing on the distant campaign. A temporary pavilion was erected between the Four-Legged Gate and the Chinese Gate, where both the Emperor and the Retired Emperor awaited them.
units.source_zh: 这一日，朝廷为远征将士送行，在四足门和唐门之间设棚，天皇和太上皇都等在这里。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这一日，朝廷为远征将士送行，在四足门和唐门之间设棚，天皇和太上皇都等在这里。

paragraphs.source_en: When the Emperor had heard him out, he bestowed food and sake upon him. When the ceremony of the three cups was over, Hideyoshi descended the steps and then entered the Retired Emperor's pavilion. Everything proceeded according to ceremony. There too, Hideyoshi received the ceremony of the three cups. He then withdrew, mounted his horse, and rode to the front of Kōmyō Shrine.

units.source_en: When the Emperor had heard him out, he bestowed food and sake upon him.
units.source_zh: 天皇听完后，便赐了酒菜。

units.source_en: When the ceremony of the three cups was over, Hideyoshi descended the steps and then entered the Retired Emperor's pavilion.
units.source_zh: 结束了三献之礼，秀吉下阶，又登上太上皇的小屋。

units.source_en: There too, Hideyoshi received the ceremony of the three cups. He then withdrew, mounted his horse, and rode to the front of Kōmyō Shrine.
units.source_zh: 秀吉在这里也接受了三献之礼，退下，骑马前往向明神社前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天皇听完后，便赐了酒菜。结束了三献之礼，秀吉下阶，又登上太上皇的小屋。一切都依礼进行。秀吉在这里也接受了三献之礼，退下，骑马前往向明神社前。

paragraphs.source_en: Totsugu received the horse standard, his body rigid with tension.

units.source_en: Totsugu received the horse standard, his body rigid with tension.
units.source_zh: 秀次僵硬而紧张地接过马印。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀次僵硬而紧张地接过马印。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not disobey anything I have told you.”

units.source_en: “Do not disobey anything I have told you.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. We shall meet again in Korea—or in the capital of the Great Ming!”

units.source_en: “Good. We shall meet again in Korea—or in the capital of the Great Ming!”
units.source_zh: “好，我们在朝鲜或大明的都城相见！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，我们在朝鲜或大明的都城相见！”

paragraphs.source_en: As soon as the column left the shrine, it assumed full military order and advanced toward Yamazaki. That night it lodged at Ibaraki Castle in Settsu, where the men exchanged their splendid garments for campaigning dress before continuing westward into the Chūgoku region. Toyotomi Hideyoshi's ambition to “set foot upon the land of Tang” was at last beginning to pass from dream into reality…

units.source_zh: 队伍一离开神社，就军容整肃，朝山崎进发，当晚在摄津的茨木城过一夜，换下华丽的衣服，朝中国地区方向去了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍一离开神社，就军容整肃，朝山崎进发，当晚在摄津的茨木城过一夜，换下华丽的衣服，朝中国地区方向去了。丰臣秀吉“踏上唐土”的志向，终于开始从梦中走向现实……
